verdict.rationale: Relay documents its own bill-pay workflow: uploading bills, automated and multi-step approval rules, and paying vendors (relay-docs-4, relay-docs-17, relay-docs-28). That covers routing invoices for payment. It also offers real-time expense categorization that syncs to QuickBooks and Xero, which only loosely implies bill coding. There is no evidence of any purchase-order matching, which is the core of the story. missing for 10: invoice-to-PO matching, explicit automated GL coding of vendor bills, AI-driven bill capture/extraction, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AP workflow.
